nodes.name: vs_rollout_gate.py
nodes.summary: MECH-269b symmetric V_s rollout gate: a consumer of per-stream V_s that substitutes the last-trusted snapshot at E1/E2 forward-predictor call sites when a stream's confidence drops below a per-side threshold, preventing rollouts off stale inputs.

nodes.name: shared_latent_probe.py

nodes.name: shared_latent_gradient_probe
nodes.summary: Computes per-module gradient norms and mean pairwise cosine on a shared latent, flagging uncoupled or net-negative-transfer conditions.

nodes.name: version_layering.py
nodes.summary: Central registry and guard helpers for higher-version (V4/V5) architecture-epoch flags, enforcing that any V4/V5 substrate change to shared ree_core code defaults OFF so V3 execution stays bit-identical. Enumerates each generation-tagged master flag so parity smokes, contract tests, and the runner preflight can mechanically assert no-op-default safety.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a NamedTuple as an immutable flag record and dotted-path attribute walking (getattr chain) to probe a built REEConfig for drift; treats a missing path as a surfaced drift signal rather than a silent pass.

nodes.name: GenerationFlag
nodes.summary: Immutable NamedTuple describing one V4/V5 master gate on a shared code path: its generation, dotted config path, no-op default value, owning claim id, and a human note.

nodes.name: find_flags_on
nodes.summary: Returns the dotted paths of any registered V4/V5 flag not sitting at its no-op default on a given config, flagging missing paths as drift; an empty result means V3 default behaviour is preserved.

nodes.name: assert_all_off
nodes.summary: Raises AssertionError naming the offending flag paths if any registered V4/V5 flag is not at its no-op default, used by the runner preflight and no-op-default contract test to guard V3-default safety.

nodes.name: iter_generation_flags
nodes.summary: Returns the registered generation flags, optionally filtered to one or more given generations (e.g. v4, v5).

nodes.name: conditioned_safety_store.py
nodes.summary: SD-051 / MECH-304 substrate: a non-trainable EMA-prototype of z_world captured at MECH-302 relief-completion event ticks; issues a cosine-similarity safety-prediction scalar consumed by the agent to gate avoidance-commitment release (IL->CeA expression pathway). SD-066 centered-readout + MECH-358 escape-affordance bridge safety-signal wiring via the 2026-07-15 predict() amendment.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure-Python stdlib arithmetic (no torch, no nn.Module inheritance); accepts torch tensors defensively via getattr/hasattr and coerces to a Python list before per-scalar EMA math.

nodes.name: ConditionedSafetyStore
nodes.summary: EMA-prototype conditioned safety predictor for SD-051 / MECH-304: learns which z_world states predict suffering absence via MECH-302 relief events (encoding pathway) and emits a sigmoid(cosine)-based safety_prediction scalar (expression pathway). Optional SD-066 centered mode subtracts a slow common-mode baseline before matching so a small cue residual can dominate under SD-008 z_world under-differentiation. MECH-094-gated: simulation ticks never advance the prototype.
nodes.languageNotes: Prototype + optional baseline held as plain Python lists updated in place; supports both raw-cosine and SD-066 centered-residue readouts under a single gain-adjusted sigmoid.

nodes.name: __init__
nodes.summary: Configures the safety store: world_dim, EMA / decay / gain / threshold knobs, and the SD-066 centered-mode toggle plus its baseline_alpha. Initialises the prototype vector, the optional common-mode baseline, and internal counters (n_events, has_prototype).

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Waking-path tick: coerces the incoming z_world into a plain list, optionally advances the SD-066 common-mode baseline EMA (skipped in centered-mode when sim_mode is set), applies per-step L2 decay toward zero, and on a MECH-302 event tick blends the (centered or raw) z_world into the prototype via ema_alpha. Returns the current safety-prediction scalar via _query. Under sim_mode returns 0.0 with no state change (MECH-094).
nodes.languageNotes: Defensive tensor coercion (detach/squeeze/tolist) keeps the class torch-free while accepting torch inputs; L2 decay + EMA implemented as scalar list comprehensions.

nodes.name: _query
nodes.summary: Internal read: returns 0.0 when the prototype norm is below min_norm (no learned cue yet); otherwise computes cosine similarity between the query vector and the prototype and maps it through a scaled sigmoid (gain * cos) to produce the safety_prediction scalar in [0,1].

nodes.name: predict
nodes.summary: Read-only prediction API added 2026-07-15 for SD-059 / MECH-358: coerces z_world into a list, applies SD-066 centering when enabled (without mutating the baseline), and returns _query(...) as the safety signal fed into the escape-affordance bridge. Never advances prototype or baseline state.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Clears the prototype and baseline back to zero vectors and resets n_events / has_prototype for a fresh developmental episode without re-instantiating the store.

nodes.name: actor_critic.py
nodes.summary: First-class actor-critic action-learning primitive (MECH-457): dorsal-striatal-analog actor with a Categorical over discrete actions plus optional plain, successor-feature, or distributional critic heads, architecturally distinct from lateral_pfc/OFC E3 bias-head REINFORCE readouts.
nodes.languageNotes: PyTorch nn.Module with dataclass step output; supports three critic modes (scalar value head, successor-feature via reward-weight vector, distributional value bins) selected by config flags.

nodes.name: ActorCriticStep
nodes.summary: Lightweight dataclass bundling one actor-critic decision step: sampled action index, log-probability, scalar value estimate, entropy, and diagnostic tensors (logits, successor phi/psi, distributional value logits).

nodes.name: ActorCriticPolicy
nodes.summary: Actor-critic policy nn.Module with shared MLP trunk, softmax policy head, and a switchable value critic (plain scalar / successor-feature reward-weighted / distributional two-hot bins); provides forward, critic loss, deterministic-or-stochastic action selection, and actor-parameter enumeration.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses torch.distributions.Categorical for stochastic sampling; ValueBins integration realises Dabney-2020-style distributional value estimation with HL-Gauss/two-hot projection.

nodes.name: event_segmenter.py
nodes.summary: MECH-288 per-tick hierarchical event boundary detector emitting monotonic outer.inner segment IDs; combines PE-threshold (fast) and BOCPD-Gaussian (slow) detectors with per-stream isolation.

nodes.name: BoundaryEvent
nodes.summary: Lightweight dataclass describing a single detected event boundary (scale, segment_id, stream) emitted by the segmenter.

nodes.name: BoundaryQueryResult
nodes.summary: Structured query result describing recent boundary firings and current segment identifiers per scale and stream.

nodes.name: Scale
nodes.summary: Descriptor for one segmentation scale (fast/slow), naming its detector type and input signals.

nodes.name: _PEThresholdDetector
nodes.summary: Fast-scale boundary detector using a sliding z-score of prediction error over z_world + z_self; fires when normalized PE exceeds threshold.

nodes.name: _BOCPDGaussianDetector
nodes.summary: Slow-scale Bayesian Online Change Point Detection detector on z_goal, using Gaussian likelihoods and top-k run-length posterior pruning.

nodes.name: EventSegmenter
nodes.summary: Top-level segmenter maintaining per-stream detectors and monotonic segment counters; exposes step/force_boundary/boundary_on APIs to downstream substrates.

nodes.name: candidate_rule_field.py

nodes.languageNotes: Pure-arithmetic regulator (no nn.Module, no learned parameters); uses cross-episode persistence, mature-pool dynamics, and availability-maintenance flags via a config dataclass.

nodes.name: CandidateRuleFieldConfig
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass carrying the 30+ tunable knobs for the CandidateRuleField substrate: slot count, mint thresholds, availability decay, tolerance-conflict gain, mature-pool dynamics, maintenance floor, cue-centering (SD-078), and cross-episode persistence.

nodes.name: CandidateRule
nodes.summary: Dataclass unit representing a single minted rule slot: pinned-direction rule_embedding, context_tag, availability, eligibility trace, minted/last-active step, active flag, and optional action_object_idx.

nodes.name: CandidateRuleField
nodes.summary: Main field substrate implementing MECH-349 CREATE (context-bucket recurrence mint), MECH-350 REPRESENT (pinned-orthogonal directions), MECH-351 GATE (tolerance-conflict admission), MECH-338 SELECT (cosine retrieval), and MECH-352 CREDIT (eligibility-trace availability updates) with cue-centering baseline (SD-078) and maintenance-hold semantics.
nodes.languageNotes: Twenty methods orchestrate mint/gate/select/credit cycles; per-step baseline EMA for common-mode invariance; MECH-094 simulation_mode gate on all state-advancing methods.

nodes.name: self_model_aggregator.py
nodes.summary: MECH-273 Phase E self-model writeback substrate: subclass of the MECH-275 BayesianAggregator specialised on the SD-003 causal_sig posterior in the 'self' domain, running bounded low-LR offline gradient passes on E2_harm_s (ARC-033) parameters using aggregator-corrected residuals as training targets. Constitutes the sleep-cluster's single explicit exception to MECH-094's no-parameter-writes-in-simulation-mode rule, scoped to E2_harm_s only.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses dataclass inheritance to extend the parent Bayesian aggregator config; guards optional torch/E2HarmSForward imports behind TYPE_CHECKING to avoid runtime coupling.

nodes.name: SelfModelAggregatorConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass extending BayesianAggregatorConfig with Phase E specific knobs: 'self' domain default, offline learning-rate scale (default 0.1), bounded step count (default 100), and an optional stdlib-random seed for reproducibility. Validates that offline_lr_scale is non-negative.

nodes.name: SelfModelAggregator
nodes.summary: Self-domain Bayesian aggregator that adds an offline gradient-pass writeback surface on top of the inherited posterior update / snapshot / decay contract. During Phase E it iterates over live 'self' posteriors (or the SWS-only last_snapshot) and runs a bounded MSE gradient descent on E2_harm_s parameters, drawing (z_harm_s, action) pairs from a waking harm-replay buffer with a synthetic fallback.

nodes.name: offline_gradient_pass
nodes.summary: Runs the MECH-273 Phase E writeback: constructs training targets from the aggregator posterior means at each replayed region, samples (z_harm_s, action) input pairs from the harm replay buffer (or a synthetic zeros + round-robin one-hot fallback), and takes n_steps bounded Adam steps on E2_harm_s parameters at an offline-scaled learning rate.

nodes.name: get_metrics
nodes.summary: Extends the parent aggregator metrics dict with Phase E specific diagnostics: cumulative offline pass count, total steps, cumulative loss, most recent loss, and the number of regions consumed by the last writeback.

nodes.name: ofc_analog.py
nodes.summary: Orbitofrontal-cortex analog module (SD-033b) providing state-code EMA and score-bias heads that inject candidate ranking bias into E3 trajectory selection, with a separate devaluation bias head decoupled from the primary discrimination head.
nodes.languageNotes: PyTorch nn.Module with register_buffer state and zeroed last-Linear inits for bit-identical OFF defaults.

nodes.name: OFCConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass configuration for OFCAnalog controlling state dim, update rate, outcome pool weight, bias scale, and gates for the state-bias head, devaluation head, and oracle usage.

nodes.name: OFCAnalog
nodes.summary: PFC-subdivision OFC analog nn.Module: maintains a per-tick EMA state code over z_world and optional z_harm, then emits per-candidate score biases via a state-bias head and an optional decoupled devaluation-bias head consumed by E3 selection.

nodes.name: __init__
nodes.summary: Constructs projection layers, state and devaluation bias-head MLPs, zeroes their last-Linear weights when not training, and registers the persistent state_code buffer for cross-tick EMA.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: MECH-261-gated EMA update of the OFC state code from projected z_world (and optional pooled z_harm) with the effective learning rate scaled by the SalienceCoordinator write gate.

nodes.name: compute_bias
nodes.summary: Concatenates the persistent state code with per-candidate z_world summaries and returns a clamped per-candidate scalar bias for E3 score composition, caching the mean-abs magnitude for diagnostics.

nodes.name: compute_devaluation_bias
nodes.summary: Emits a per-candidate bias from the decoupled devaluation head clamped to devaluation_bias_scale so that outcome revaluation can shift ranking beyond the primary bias-head clamp band.

nodes.name: query_outcome
nodes.summary: MECH-263 outcome-oracle path that runs the caller-supplied E2 harm-forward model under no_grad on detached inputs and caches the last prediction for diagnostics.

nodes.name: get_state
nodes.summary: Returns a diagnostics dict exposing state-code norm, last bias magnitudes, and oracle readiness/prediction stats used by experiment manifests and downstream governance readouts.

nodes.name: GoalConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass parameterizing z_goal attractor dynamics (alpha/decay), drive modulation (SD-012), seeding gates, valence-liking floor, and SD-057 IncentiveTokenBank + MECH-189 SuperOrdinalGoalMemory sub-flags.

nodes.name: SuperOrdinalGoalMemory

nodes.name: IncentiveTokenBank

nodes.name: GoalState
nodes.summary: Persistent z_goal attractor with EMA update, drive-gated seeding threshold, SD-092 hierarchical parent-goal credit, SD-093 progress-velocity effort modulation, and MECH-188 injection view for scoring.

nodes.name: structured_curiosity.py
nodes.summary: Pure-arithmetic MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus regulator combining novelty (314a), uncertainty (314b), and learning-progress (314c) sub-flavors into a per-candidate E3 score bias with auto-augmentation streak tracking.
nodes.languageNotes: Sibling-pattern regulator (no nn.Module, no learned params) exposing three independently-togglable sub-flavours for Q-044 ablation; MECH-094 simulation-mode gated.

nodes.name: StructuredCuriosityConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding MECH-314 curiosity master switch, three sub-flavour flags, per-flavour weights, clamp scale, LP EMA/window parameters, and Phase-2 novelty auto-augmentation controls.

nodes.name: StructuredCuriosity
nodes.summary: Pure-arithmetic curiosity regulator that composes MECH-314a novelty, MECH-314b uncertainty, and MECH-314c learning-progress into a clamped per-candidate score bias, honoring MECH-094 simulation-mode gating and tracking auto-augmentation streaks.
nodes.languageNotes: Non-nn.Module regulator with three orthogonally-toggleable channels; state is scalars/ring buffers only; broadcast Phase-1 for 314b/c with per-candidate 314a.

nodes.name: __init__
nodes.summary: Validates all StructuredCuriosityConfig sub-flags, weights, gains, thresholds, and window sizes; raises ValueError on any invalid setting before initializing counters and LP ring buffer.

nodes.name: compute_score_bias
nodes.summary: Main per-tick entry point that dispatches to Phase-2 novelty when enabled, composes weighted MECH-314a/b/c contributions into a K-length bias vector, clamps to +/-bias_scale, and records diagnostic ranges and rail hits.

nodes.name: _compute_novelty_phase2
nodes.summary: Phase-2 novelty computation that consumes coerced RBF centers, monitors candidate spread against the min-spread threshold, updates auto-augmentation streaks, and toggles first-action one-hot augmentation when the streak triggers.

nodes.name: _candidate_spread
nodes.summary: Computes mean pairwise L2 distance across K candidate summaries under no_grad as a scalar spread diagnostic feeding the auto-augmentation streak controller.

nodes.name: _update_augmentation_streak
nodes.summary: Advances or resets the consecutive-low-spread streak counter, flipping first-action one-hot augmentation on when the streak crosses the configured tick threshold.

nodes.name: _coerce_source_to_centers
nodes.summary: Normalizes heterogeneous novelty-source inputs (lists, tensors, arrays) into a detached [N,D] tensor on the target device for Phase-2 novelty processing.

nodes.name: _compute_novelty
nodes.summary: MECH-314a per-candidate novelty via minimum distance from each candidate's first-step z_world to the nearest active RBF center, optionally augmented with first-action one-hots, normalized by mean signature norm.

nodes.name: _compute_uncertainty
nodes.summary: MECH-314b uncertainty scalar read from E3 running variance, broadcast in Phase-1 across candidates and normalized to a nonnegative float.

nodes.name: update_prediction_error
nodes.summary: Feeds a per-tick prediction-error scalar into the MECH-314c learning-progress ring buffer and refreshes the LP EMA of |PE_t - PE_{t-K}|, gated by simulation_mode to protect replay paths.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Clears LP ring buffer, EMA state, augmentation streak/state, and per-tick diagnostic counters on episode reset.

nodes.name: get_state
nodes.summary: Returns a diagnostic dict of curiosity state including LP buffer size, EMA value, augmentation streak, and per-flavour contribution ranges for downstream logging and Q-044 ablation checks.

nodes.name: manifest_spool.py
nodes.summary: Filesystem spool that lets the /result HTTP endpoint persist raw manifest bytes and companion sidefiles keyed on run_id, so the Phase 3 sole-git-writer in sync_daemon.py can later commit them into REE_assembly without touching git from the runner. Every write is atomic-rename with sha256 verification and gated on the COORDINATOR_SPOOL_DIR environment flag; layout is <spool>/pending/<run_id>.json plus <spool>/sidefiles/pending/<run_id>/<relpath>.
nodes.languageNotes: Filesystem-level path safety: every path is verified via resolve().relative_to(root) before touching disk, defending against traversal via crafted run_ids or manifest_relpaths from POST payloads.

nodes.name: spool_root
nodes.summary: Returns the configured COORDINATOR_SPOOL_DIR as a Path, or None when the env var is unset — the master feature switch for all spool writes.

nodes.name: write_manifest
nodes.summary: Atomically writes a manifest and its metadata sidecar for a given run_id: rejects unsafe run_ids, hashes-and-verifies incoming bytes, uses tmp-then-rename with fsync so a crash never leaves a half-file for the writer to consume.

nodes.name: count_pending
nodes.summary: Counts .json files currently sitting in the pending manifest directory — a health-check hook the coordinator exposes to detect backpressure.

nodes.name: list_pending_run_ids
nodes.summary: Enumerates run_ids with pending manifests, deduplicated by pairing .json and .meta.json files, so the writer can process each run atomically.

nodes.name: read_manifest
nodes.summary: Reads the raw manifest bytes for a pending run_id, returning None if either the run_id is unsafe or the file is missing (a caller may have already consumed it).

nodes.name: read_meta
nodes.summary: Reads the JSON metadata sidecar (received_at, sha, optional manifest_relpath hint) accompanying a pending manifest.

nodes.name: delete_manifest
nodes.summary: Removes the manifest and its metadata sidecar after a successful writer commit; tolerates missing files so partial-crash recovery is idempotent.

nodes.name: derive_evidence_relpath
nodes.summary: Resolves where in REE_assembly a manifest should land: prefers the runner-supplied manifest_relpath (validated safe), otherwise falls back to evidence/experiments/<run_id>.json to match the legacy flat layout.

nodes.name: safe_companion_relpath
nodes.summary: Validates a sidefile relative path against traversal and absolute-path attacks before it is used as a filesystem key inside the sidefile spool.

nodes.name: write_sidefile
nodes.summary: Spools a companion sidefile under <spool>/sidefiles/pending/<run_id>/<relpath> using tmp-then-rename with sha256 verification, so the writer can later either commit it alongside its manifest or quarantine it under the oversized threshold.

nodes.name: list_pending_sidefile_run_ids
nodes.summary: Enumerates run_ids that currently have queued sidefiles, so the writer can pair them with their manifest at commit time.

nodes.name: list_sidefiles_for_run
nodes.summary: Recursively lists every sidefile currently spooled for a given run_id along with its safe companion relpath, filtering out any traversal-unsafe entries a partial crash may have left behind.

nodes.name: delete_sidefiles
nodes.summary: Removes every sidefile and metadata for a run and cleans up empty parent directories, called by the writer after a successful commit of the run's sidefile set.

nodes.name: placemarker_relpath_for
nodes.summary: Returns the deterministic relpath under which an oversized-sidefile placemarker is stored — a small JSON stub that lives in git while the real payload sits in cloud storage.

nodes.name: sha256_of_file
nodes.summary: Streams a file through hashlib.sha256 in 1MB chunks to compute a stable content hash without loading the whole payload — used both to verify writes and to fingerprint oversized sidefiles in placemarkers.

nodes.name: build_oversized_sidefile_placemarker
nodes.summary: Constructs the JSON body of an oversized-sidefile placemarker recording the sha, size, oversized threshold, external storage locations, and a note explaining that the real bytes were quarantined off-git.

nodes.name: theta_buffer.py
nodes.summary: ThetaBuffer implements cross-rate integration for MECH-089/SD-006, giving E3 temporally-averaged theta-cycle summaries of z_world/z_self instead of raw per-tick E1/E2 output. Supports SD-100 phase-weighted summaries and MECH-122 consolidation-mode packaging.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure PyTorch scalar/tensor arithmetic, no nn.Module; uses collections.deque as the rolling backing store.

nodes.name: ThetaBuffer

nodes.name: ReafferencePredictor
nodes.summary: SD-007 / MECH-098 / MECH-101 module that predicts the z_world change caused purely by self-motion (perspective shift) and subtracts it from raw z_world, using the previous z_world_raw plus prior action.

nodes.name: HarmEncoder
nodes.summary: SD-010 dedicated nociceptive encoder (ARC-027) that maps harm observations to z_harm, kept outside the reafference pipeline because harm is never perspective-corrected.

nodes.name: AffectiveHarmEncoder
nodes.summary: SD-011 C-fiber/paleospinothalamic analog (ARC-033) encoding EMA-smoothed harm-proximity observations into z_harm_a and feeding E3 commit gating directly (not counterfactually predicted).

nodes.name: ResourceEncoder
nodes.summary: SD-015 / MECH-112 encoder that maps world observations to z_resource independent of z_world, providing a 'what to seek' signal for GoalState; supports an SD-049 Phase-2 identity classifier head for resource-type discrimination.

nodes.name: HarmForwardModel
nodes.summary: Monolithic harm forward model used prior to the trunk/head refactor, predicting future harm-stream state from current z_harm and action context.

nodes.name: HarmForwardTrunk
nodes.summary: Shared harm-stream feature trunk (ARC-058) consumed by HarmForwardHead and ResidualHarmForward to keep sensory and affective harm predictions on a common representational basis.

nodes.name: HarmForwardHead
nodes.summary: Prediction head on top of HarmForwardTrunk that projects the shared harm features into a per-stream forward prediction (sensory or affective).

nodes.name: ResidualHarmForward
nodes.summary: Residual variant of the harm forward model that composes trunk plus head with a residual connection, letting the head learn only the delta on top of the trunk representation.

nodes.name: HarmBridge
nodes.summary: Bridge module that couples the harm forward model back into the shared latent stack so harm-stream predictions can influence downstream latent updates or E3 commit gating.

nodes.name: _GradReverseFn
nodes.summary: Custom torch.autograd.Function that acts as identity in the forward pass and reverses/scales gradients in the backward pass; used by AdversarialSplitHead for gradient-reversal training.

nodes.name: AdversarialSplitHead
nodes.summary: Adversarial head that uses _GradReverseFn to encourage disentanglement between z_self and z_world, exposing split_losses() so the training loop can add an adversarial cross-prediction penalty.

nodes.name: LatentState
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding one timestep of the latent stack (z_self, z_world, z_beta, z_theta, z_delta, optional harm/affective/resource channels, precision dict, timestamp) with helpers to flatten, move devices, and detach.

nodes.name: SplitEncoder
nodes.summary: SD-005 bottom-up split encoder that maps body observations to z_self and world observations to z_world under top-down conditioning, with optional heads for harm lateral input, event classification, resource-proximity/field supervision and a world-encoder skip connection.

nodes.name: SharedDepthEncoder
nodes.summary: Precision-gated MLP block used to build the shared depth stack (beta -> theta -> delta), taking an input latent plus optional top-down signal and returning encoded features scaled by a learned precision.

nodes.name: LatentStack
nodes.summary: V3 multi-timescale latent-stack nn.Module composing SplitEncoder, SharedDepthEncoder tiers, optional ReafferencePredictor, SelfRecurrenceCell (SELF-1/DR-13), harm/affective/resource encoders, and prediction heads; refuses incoherent iterative-inference configs at construction (F-C4 audit).
